0022600108.text: The Bulls (1-1, third in the Central and 0.5 games back, eighth in the East) host the Wizards (1-0, second in the Southeast and fifth in the East), with Chicago on a one-game winning streak and still 0-0 at home. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (pinched nerve in the hip). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls won the season series 3-0, including a 119-108 win in Washington on April 9, 2026.
